calibration_sensitivity.interpretation: The 69 pending verdicts provide empirical measurement of human judging speed tau and human-vs-label discordance delta_h. If human agreement is 90% (10% discordance) at 2.5 min/card, effective yield shifts from 24.0 to 21.6 TP/hr.

recommendation.justification: Policy 1 (Top-K Priority) strictly dominates all alternatives on expected true positives per judge-hour (24.0 TP/hr at 2.5 min/card vs 16.0 for Family Caps and 20.8 for Uncertainty+Control). At budget K=30 cards/day, human review burden is exactly 1.25 hours/day (at 2.5 min/card; 1.0h at 2m, 1.5h at 3m), achieving 100% precision [88.6%, 100.0%] and significantly outperforming uniform random sampling (p = 3.36e-02 via exact McNemar).
